title: DO! NUTS TOKYO — Social Innovation Platform
jpTitle: DO! NUTS TOKYO — ソーシャルイノベーションプラットフォーム

summary.en: Launched DO! NUTS TOKYO, a citizen-facing sustainability sub-brand of Value Frontier supporting Tokyo's target of near-zero CO2 emissions by 2050. Led branding, digital platform design and workshop facilitation, designing frameworks that generated sustainability proposals from youth ambassadors across three cohorts. Won the 2021 American Graphic Design Award.
summary.jp: 東京都の CO2 実質ゼロ目標に向けた。姉妹ブランド DO! NUTS TOKYO を立ち上げた。ブランドと基盤設計、運営を担当。3 期続く若者大使制度をつくり、2021 年 AGDA を受賞。

business.en: The brand DNA built for Value Frontier's own corporate repositioning was reapplied to a public-facing civic platform — evidence the underlying brand work was durable enough to carry into a different institution and audience entirely.
business.jp: Value Frontier の再定義用に作ったブランドの核を転用した。公共向け市民プラットフォームでも通用した。違う組織にも耐える強さがあった証。

mine: Applied the brand DNA developed in the Value Frontier project to a citizen-facing sustainability platform
Led branding, digital platform design and workshop facilitation
Designed workshop frameworks that generated sustainability proposals from youth ambassadors, expanding the program to a third cohort
Designed a vibrant, approachable visual system with multiple logo configurations for different contexts
team: Client executive team, designers, a social media strategist and a web development team — credited on the page without individual task breakdown

label.en: youth ambassador program expanded to a third cohort
label.jp: 若者大使制度、3 期継続

narrative.problem: To hit near-zero CO2 emissions by 2050, Tokyo needed more than policy — it needed a platform that could engage citizens, corporations and especially youth in sustainability, making climate action feel accessible, creative and participatory rather than bureaucratic.

_notes: Engagement recorded as freelance based on roles.json's cie evidence list, which includes dnt.
No explicit project year on the page; the 2021 AGDA award year is recorded as a metric, not as the project period.

cardLine.en: Tokyo's citizen-facing sustainability brand, run as workshops with youth ambassadors.
cardLine.jp: 東京の市民向けサステナビリティブランド。若者アンバサダーとのワークショップで動かした。
